hero.title: Two ways to
hero.description: Cervical screening is a short test that looks for HPV. Choose how you would like to do it and we will walk you through what to expect.
hero.prompt: How would you like to be screened?

home.title: From home
home.description: Order a self-collection kit by phone and do the swab in private.

gp.title: At a GP clinic
gp.description: Have your GP or nurse do the test, or collect your own swab in a private space.

home.label: Option 1 · From home
home.title: Screening
home.description: If you can't get to a clinic, you may be able to book a telehealth appointment and have a self-collection kit sent to you. The swab is quick, private and just as accurate at detecting HPV.
home.note: Kits can't be bought at a pharmacy or posted out automatically. You need to arrange one through a healthcare provider. If you have unusual bleeding, pain or discharge, see your GP instead.

call.title: Call to order your kit
call.description: Phone your GP or a telehealth service and ask for a self-collection kit. Ask about cost too: the test is free, but a consultation fee may apply.

collect.title: Collect your sample
collect.description: Wash your hands, then gently insert the swab and rotate it 2 to 3 times for about 10 seconds. It should not hurt.

return.title: Return it and get your result
return.description: Put the swab back in its tube and return it as your provider instructs. They will contact you with your result.

gp.label: Option 2 · At a GP clinic
gp.title: Screening
gp.description: A doctor or specially trained nurse can do your test in a few minutes. You can choose a clinician-collected test, or collect your own swab in a private space.
gp.note: Ask for a self-collection swab if you prefer. It is a good idea to call ahead to confirm the clinic offers it.

book.title: Find and book
book.description: Book with a GP, community health centre or women's health centre. Call ahead to ask about self-collection and any consultation fee.

test.title: Have your test
test.description: Your clinician takes a sample with a small brush, or you swab yourself behind a screen. You can ask questions at any time.

result.title: Get your result
result.description: Your sample goes to a lab and your provider will let you know the result. Most people only need to repeat it every 5 years.

ai.label: Practise first
ai.title: Nervous about
ai.description: To order a kit you will need to phone a clinic or telehealth service. Our AI lets you rehearse that conversation first, at your own pace, so the real call feels familiar.
